done_when: forge.toml pins v1.1.0, forge sync has rewritten the generated files for it, and the repo's tests pass

dismissals.because: forge.toml:2 this fix only moves the Forge pin and the files forge sync regenerates; it changes no app behaviour, and Forge's own test suite covers sync and approval, not this app's suite

findings.body: The upgrade has no test through Forge's real entry point, despite the explicit test requirement. `package.json:86–88` runs the application unit and integration suites; inspecting their configured test directories found no Forge invocation. The workflow's `forge hook pr-check` checks PR admission, not sync or main-chat story approval. Add a suite-wired test using the pinned Forge release that verifies generated-file consistency and exercises the approval flow this upgrade is intended to repair.
findings.title: Not done: Forge v1.1.0 sync and main-chat approval end-to-end test

why: This repo pins Forge v1.0.2 while v1.1.0 is released, so the one main chat can't approve its stories
